meta.title: Sacrifice
meta.description: Passion, when taken to its extremes, becomes apathy.

units.rawText: Ascension Sector, former Admin Center area outskirts.
units.displayText: Ascension Sector, former Admin Center area outskirts.

spans.text: Ascension Sector, former Admin Center area outskirts.

units.rawText: How radiant... the God that I have longed for with Avram for so long.
units.displayText: How radiant... the God that I have longed for with Avram for so long.

spans.text: How radiant... the God that I have longed for with Avram for so long.

units.rawText: Avram... ah, Lind, rather. Behold—
units.displayText: Avram... ah, Lind, rather. Behold—

spans.text: Avram... ah, Lind, rather. Behold—

units.rawText: We've created an existence great and vast so that you may become the meridian of this forsaken world.
units.displayText: We've created an existence great and vast so that you may become the meridian of this forsaken world.

spans.text: We've created an existence great and vast so that you may become the meridian of this forsaken world.

units.rawText: You shall guide us, this flock of agents, lost in chaos and turmoil, and seek a new... gah!
units.displayText: You shall guide us, this flock of agents, lost in chaos and turmoil, and seek a new... gah!

spans.text: You shall guide us, this flock of agents, lost in chaos and turmoil, and seek a new... gah!

units.rawText: A shape of dazzling white shot forth from the ruins, hurtling towards the midair Creation like a morningstar.
units.displayText: A shape of dazzling white shot forth from the ruins, hurtling towards the midair Creation like a morningstar.

spans.text: A shape of dazzling white shot forth from the ruins, hurtling towards the midair Creation like a morningstar.

units.rawText: Then came a strange Sanctifier. In his hands, he held sickle and chain. He grinned yet was stone-faced, was grievous yet contemptuous. He appeared conceited but remained prudent.
units.displayText: Then came a strange Sanctifier. In his hands, he held sickle and chain. He grinned yet was stone-faced, was grievous yet contemptuous. He appeared conceited but remained prudent.

spans.text: Then came a strange Sanctifier. In his hands, he held sickle and chain. He grinned yet was stone-faced, was grievous yet contemptuous. He appeared conceited but remained prudent.

units.rawText: And thus, judgment is passed.
units.displayText: And thus, judgment is passed.

spans.text: And thus, judgment is passed.

units.rawText: Still airborne, the monster's mountainous frame trembled as if savoring the agony.
units.displayText: Still airborne, the monster's mountainous frame trembled as if savoring the agony.

spans.text: Still airborne, the monster's mountainous frame trembled as if savoring the agony.

units.rawText: At that very moment, a parcel of that pain was dispensed to Elaugh through a certain special connection.
units.displayText: At that very moment, a parcel of that pain was dispensed to Elaugh through a certain special connection.

spans.text: At that very moment, a parcel of that pain was dispensed to Elaugh through a certain special connection.

units.rawText: Ah... hah... that hurts... burns...
units.displayText: Ah... hah... that hurts... burns...

spans.text: Ah... hah... that hurts... burns...

units.rawText: God? No more than a blasphemous object, an accumulation of impurities and putrefactions, and you dare call it a God.
units.displayText: God? No more than a blasphemous object, an accumulation of impurities and putrefactions, and you dare call it a God.

spans.text: God? No more than a blasphemous object, an accumulation of impurities and putrefactions, and you dare call it a God.

units.rawText: Spurning the Reverse Babylon Tower Safety Treaty, assaulting Sanctifiers, leading the sector towards aberrancy.
units.displayText: Spurning the Reverse Babylon Tower Safety Treaty, assaulting Sanctifiers, leading the sector towards aberrancy.

spans.text: Spurning the Reverse Babylon Tower Safety Treaty, assaulting Sanctifiers, leading the sector towards aberrancy.

units.rawText: Judgment's contralto tones reverbed through the sector. For each transgression he announced, the conflagration beneath him grew brighter.
units.displayText: Judgment's contralto tones reverbed through the sector. For each transgression he announced, the conflagration beneath him grew brighter.

spans.text: Judgment's contralto tones reverbed through the sector. For each transgression he announced, the conflagration beneath him grew brighter.

units.rawText: The Great Creation emitted a series of strange cries at the flame's touch, its indeterminate yet weighty sounds diffusing through the sector.
units.displayText: The Great Creation emitted a series of strange cries at the flame's touch, its indeterminate yet weighty sounds diffusing through the sector.

spans.text: The Great Creation emitted a series of strange cries at the flame's touch, its indeterminate yet weighty sounds diffusing through the sector.

units.rawText: It was as if the agents within earshot were struck to their very being, collectively stopping in their tracks.
units.displayText: It was as if the agents within earshot were struck to their very being, collectively stopping in their tracks.

spans.text: It was as if the agents within earshot were struck to their very being, collectively stopping in their tracks.

units.rawText: What are you... You dare to tarnish the form of our God?!
units.displayText: What are you... You dare to tarnish the form of our God?!

spans.text: What are you... You dare to tarnish the form of our God?!

units.rawText: I... won't allow you to desecrate this great work!
units.displayText: I... won't allow you to desecrate this great work!

spans.text: I... won't allow you to desecrate this great work!

units.rawText: Elaugh, fighting through the shared pain, forcibly invoked her administrators rights to broadcast across the entire sector.
units.displayText: Elaugh, fighting through the shared pain, forcibly invoked her administrators rights to broadcast across the entire sector.

spans.text: Elaugh, fighting through the shared pain, forcibly invoked her administrators rights to broadcast across the entire sector.

units.rawText: Agents of the Ascension Sector, we've succeeded. We've created something more than human, a God presiding above all.
units.displayText: Agents of the Ascension Sector, we've succeeded. We've created something more than human, a God presiding above all.

spans.text: Agents of the Ascension Sector, we've succeeded. We've created something more than human, a God presiding above all.

units.rawText: And now, those Sanctifiers, those imbecilic machines of slaughter, would seek to defile our God.
units.displayText: And now, those Sanctifiers, those imbecilic machines of slaughter, would seek to defile our God.

spans.text: And now, those Sanctifiers, those imbecilic machines of slaughter, would seek to defile our God.

units.rawText: Can we stand by and allow this?! No... never!
units.displayText: Can we stand by and allow this?! No... never!

spans.text: Can we stand by and allow this?! No... never!

units.rawText: Let us <size=40>fight for our God!</size> <size=44>Nay, give ourselves for our God!</size>
units.displayText: Let us fight for our God! Nay, give ourselves for our God!

spans.text: Let us
fight for our God!
Nay, give ourselves for our God!

units.rawText: Elaugh's words proliferated through the minds of every agent in the sector, infecting and irrefutable.
units.displayText: Elaugh's words proliferated through the minds of every agent in the sector, infecting and irrefutable.

spans.text: Elaugh's words proliferated through the minds of every agent in the sector, infecting and irrefutable.

units.rawText: Give... ourselves... for... our... God...
units.displayText: Give... ourselves... for... our... God...

spans.text: Give... ourselves... for... our... God...

units.rawText: Give ourselves... for our God.
units.displayText: Give ourselves... for our God.

spans.text: Give ourselves... for our God.

units.rawText: Give ourselves for our God.
units.displayText: Give ourselves for our God.

spans.text: Give ourselves for our God.

units.rawText: The agents muttered under their breath, unfalteringly changing their course of action.
units.displayText: The agents muttered under their breath, unfalteringly changing their course of action.

spans.text: The agents muttered under their breath, unfalteringly changing their course of action.

units.rawText: From the corners of the Earth, they came—from beneath the Sanctifiers' tongues of fire, from the ruins; be they crippled or mutilated, be they whole and unbroken, they scuttled towards Judgment.
units.displayText: From the corners of the Earth, they came—from beneath the Sanctifiers' tongues of fire, from the ruins; be they crippled or mutilated, be they whole and unbroken, they scuttled towards Judgment.

spans.text: From the corners of the Earth, they came—from beneath the Sanctifiers' tongues of fire, from the ruins; be they crippled or mutilated, be they whole and unbroken, they scuttled towards Judgment.

units.rawText: The scorching and incinerating brilliance was now trivial to them, their mechanical pupils emotionless voids.
units.displayText: The scorching and incinerating brilliance was now trivial to them, their mechanical pupils emotionless voids.

spans.text: The scorching and incinerating brilliance was now trivial to them, their mechanical pupils emotionless voids.

units.rawText: <color=red><size=60>For our God!</size></color>
units.displayText: For our God!

spans.text: For our God!

units.rawText: Ascension Sector, a block near the former Admin Center area.
units.displayText: Ascension Sector, a block near the former Admin Center area.

spans.text: Ascension Sector, a block near the former Admin Center area.

units.rawText: De Lacey brought a cluster of agents back to a tentatively safe area, giving her all in medicating what she can.
units.displayText: De Lacey brought a cluster of agents back to a tentatively safe area, giving her all in medicating what she can.

spans.text: De Lacey brought a cluster of agents back to a tentatively safe area, giving her all in medicating what she can.

units.rawText: Way too many medium to heavy injuries, these agents... Do they not pay any attention to themselves when they're out in the field?
units.displayText: Way too many medium to heavy injuries, these agents... Do they not pay any attention to themselves when they're out in the field?

spans.text: Way too many medium to heavy injuries, these agents... Do they not pay any attention to themselves when they're out in the field?

units.rawText: A sudden fusillade of dampened explosions could be heard, and De Lacey instinctively looked towards the air.
units.displayText: A sudden fusillade of dampened explosions could be heard, and De Lacey instinctively looked towards the air.

spans.text: A sudden fusillade of dampened explosions could be heard, and De Lacey instinctively looked towards the air.

units.rawText: That's... a Greater Sanctifier?!
units.displayText: That's... a Greater Sanctifier?!

spans.text: That's... a Greater Sanctifier?!

units.rawText: Before she could grasp the situation, the agents around began to rouse.
units.displayText: Before she could grasp the situation, the agents around began to rouse.

spans.text: Before she could grasp the situation, the agents around began to rouse.

units.rawText: Give ourselves... for our God...
units.displayText: Give ourselves... for our God...

spans.text: Give ourselves... for our God...

units.rawText: Where do you think you're going with a body as busted up as that?
units.displayText: Where do you think you're going with a body as busted up as that?

spans.text: Where do you think you're going with a body as busted up as that?

units.rawText: Watching as the agents under Elaugh's influence began to rise one after another, De Lacey was forced to take her tail apart into a much greater amount of functionless data cables, turning them into shackles for the agents.
units.displayText: Watching as the agents under Elaugh's influence began to rise one after another, De Lacey was forced to take her tail apart into a much greater amount of functionless data cables, turning them into shackles for the agents.

spans.text: Watching as the agents under Elaugh's influence began to rise one after another, De Lacey was forced to take her tail apart into a much greater amount of functionless data cables, turning them into shackles for the agents.

units.rawText: <size=40>Sit still for a bit!</size>
units.displayText: Sit still for a bit!

spans.text: Sit still for a bit!

units.rawText: For... our God... Fight... for our God...
units.displayText: For... our God... Fight... for our God...

spans.text: For... our God... Fight... for our God...

units.rawText: You lot...
units.displayText: You lot...

spans.text: You lot...

units.rawText: As more and more agents began to move, De Lacey's strength began to fade.
units.displayText: As more and more agents began to move, De Lacey's strength began to fade.

spans.text: As more and more agents began to move, De Lacey's strength began to fade.

units.rawText: Not like this... I gotta think of something else... De Lacey, think of something.
units.displayText: Not like this... I gotta think of something else... De Lacey, think of something.

spans.text: Not like this... I gotta think of something else... De Lacey, think of something.

units.rawText: Another agent took a series of shaky steps toward the door. De Lacey subconsciously tugs at the data cable, causing the agent's marred body to fall apart on the spot.
units.displayText: Another agent took a series of shaky steps toward the door. De Lacey subconsciously tugs at the data cable, causing the agent's marred body to fall apart on the spot.

spans.text: Another agent took a series of shaky steps toward the door. De Lacey subconsciously tugs at the data cable, causing the agent's marred body to fall apart on the spot.

units.rawText: ...Our God... For our God... Krak—
units.displayText: ...Our God... For our God... Krak—

spans.text: ...Our God... For our God... Krak—

units.rawText: Ahh... Sorry!
units.displayText: Ahh... Sorry!

spans.text: Ahh... Sorry!

units.rawText: What do I do? Their bodies can't handle any significant movement, and there are too many of them, no room for precision...
units.displayText: What do I do? Their bodies can't handle any significant movement, and there are too many of them, no room for precision...

spans.text: What do I do? Their bodies can't handle any significant movement, and there are too many of them, no room for precision...

units.rawText: Have some composure. They're patients. Think of what you did before...
units.displayText: Have some composure. They're patients. Think of what you did before...

spans.text: Have some composure. They're patients. Think of what you did before...

units.rawText: ...Right! They're patients! Patients who are weak in body and mentally jeopardized!
units.displayText: ...Right! They're patients! Patients who are weak in body and mentally jeopardized!

spans.text: ...Right! They're patients! Patients who are weak in body and mentally jeopardized!

units.rawText: Their neural systems are critically compromised! The problem is with their neural cloud, not their body!
units.displayText: Their neural systems are critically compromised! The problem is with their neural cloud, not their body!

spans.text: Their neural systems are critically compromised! The problem is with their neural cloud, not their body!

units.rawText: De Lacey, now far more aware of the problem, quickly changed up her methods.
units.displayText: De Lacey, now far more aware of the problem, quickly changed up her methods.

spans.text: De Lacey, now far more aware of the problem, quickly changed up her methods.

units.rawText: Emotional System Pacifying Fluid injecting...
units.displayText: Emotional System Pacifying Fluid injecting...

spans.text: Emotional System Pacifying Fluid injecting...

units.rawText: Low-pressure relief electrical currents activating...
units.displayText: Low-pressure relief electrical currents activating...

spans.text: Low-pressure relief electrical currents activating...

units.displayText: De Lacey prevented the agents from moving, giving them special treatment one by one.

spans.text: De Lacey prevented the agents from moving, giving them special treatment one by one.

units.rawText: Ugh... ah... the last... the last one...
units.displayText: Ugh... ah... the last... the last one...

spans.text: Ugh... ah... the last... the last one...

units.rawText: For our... for...
units.displayText: For our... for...

spans.text: For our... for...

units.rawText: God... Zzz...
units.displayText: God... Zzz...

spans.text: God... Zzz...

units.displayText: She collapsed to the ground, exhausted, half-leaning on the wall, blinking communications device by her side.

units.displayText: In her gradually blurring vision, a strange familiar agent stood up.

units.rawText: The agent looked towards the center of the conflict, seemingly desirous to join the fray, but ultimately did not tear off De Lacey's cable.
units.displayText: The agent looked towards the center of the conflict, seemingly desirous to join the fray, but ultimately did not tear off De Lacey's cable.

units.displayText: Lind?!

units.displayText: Is that you, Lind?

units.displayText: Lind! Don't be stupid!
